name: Follow the Walton Trail
summary: The Walton Trail turns local streets and landmarks into four self-guided routes, including the river and a family-friendly postbox trail, making it an easy way to notice details even long-term residents may have missed.
reasonToVisit: Four self-guided routes through Walton's streets and landmarks, free to follow any time
planningDetail: Choose from four routes, including a family-friendly postbox trail
